title: Single hieratic sign, D. Assiut N13.1 TN37 (AKU HT 14116)

object.name: D. Assiut N13.1 TN37
object.content: Besuchertext (Scribe Men); Kolophon (Scribe Men); Opferformel ḥtp-ḏı͗-nsw.t (scribe Men to Osiris and Anubis)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Svenja A. Gülden, Ursula Verhoeven; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 14116

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 14116; AKU grapheme M0210 (AKU GR 368). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: M17 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 282. Occurrence: line 6; find place Gebel Assiut al-gharbi; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 21 x 8 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Neues Reich, 18. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Svenja A. Gülden, Ursula Verhoeven. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
